project_type: FastAPI (async SQLAlchemy + SQLite) Python backend for Awaaz Pakistan. Hybrid complaint parser: local Ollama (qwen2.5:1.5b-instruct) + deterministic rule engine. faster-whisper for voice (lazy-imported). This task is BACKEND-ONLY; frontend is untouched.
build_system: Plain venv, no build step. QUIRK: faster-whisper import is LAZY on purpose; openai-whisper, PyAV `av`, and `tiktoken` are BLOCKED by Windows Smart App Control and must NEVER import at module load. Do not touch the lazy-whisper machinery in ai_pipeline.py.
test_framework: pytest in awaaz_backend/tests (test_pipeline.py, test_multi_item.py, test_nlp_rules.py, test_rates.py, test_api.py, test_audio.py).
build_command: No build. Import/behavior is checked via pytest.
test_command: From awaaz_backend with DATABASE_URL unset: `$env:DATABASE_URL=$null; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/ -q`. Baseline before changes = 37 passed for tests/test_pipeline.py tests/test_nlp_rules.py tests/test_rates.py tests/test_multi_item.py (with Ollama live).
verification_instructions: From awaaz_backend, ALWAYS `$env:DATABASE_URL=$null` first. Unit: `.\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/ -q`. Targeted probes use `.\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "..."` importing ai_pipeline / services.rates / services.nlp_rules. Live HTTP (optional): start a FRESH `.\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --port 8040` (the dev backend holds port 8000 — never reuse it), POST the English/Pashto/Punjabi examples to /api/complaints/text, assert each item carries its own price, then shut the server down and DELETE any scratch .db it created. Ollama is live at http://localhost:11434.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Backend venv ALREADY set up at awaaz_backend/venv — invoke .\venv\Scripts\python.exe from awaaz_backend; do NOT recreate it. DATABASE_URL MUST be unset when running pytest/live. Dev backend already holds port 8000 — live tests must use port 8040 and shut down after + remove scratch DB. Keep whisper/faster-whisper import LAZY. Do NOT change auth/CORS/admin-key or DB schema. Do NOT undo the under-rate filtering in routers/complaints.py (_persist_submission._is_registrable keeps non-price items + price<=0 for review, drops PERA-Overpricing items with reported_price>0 and percentage_overcharge<=0; MultiComplaintResponse.primary is Optional with an explanatory message when nothing registers). Preserve that. Commit locally on polish/final; do NOT push.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering present. All non-English/Urdu native spellings (Pashto, Sindhi, Balochi) MUST carry a greppable NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED code comment; do not overstate fidelity. Follow Conventional Commits for local commits.
key_patterns: parse_complaint_items(text) -> list of per-item dicts (15 keys). Flow: detect_language -> classify_category_and_urgency -> _segment_clauses -> rule discovery (_discover_items_by_rules over clauses using rate_service.find_all_items) + optional LLM list (_call_ollama_llm_multi, mapped to clauses via _attribute_clause) -> merge/de-dupe by canonical id (rule price authoritative when >0) -> _reconcile_item per item -> sort by overcharge desc. _segment_clauses splits on `. ۔ ! ? \n bhi بھی aur اور and tay o ، ,` and currently MISSES Pashto ` او `, Punjabi ` تے `, Sindhi ` ۽ `. _price_clause_for handles single-item own/borrow-next (` bhi ` trailing). When a clause has 2+ commodities each currently reads extract_price_and_normalize(WHOLE clause)[first price] -> the price-steal bug. rate_service.find_all_items matches aliases on Unicode word boundary (?<!\w)alias(?!\w) (confirmed \w matches Arabic script); greedy fuzzy tier is deliberately excluded to keep the 7-item test free of a phantom Chicken — DO NOT reintroduce loose substring matching.
key_findings_confirmed_live: 1) Pashto example 'ٹماٹر 250 ... او چینی 180 ...' stays ONE clause (no ` او ` split) so چینی borrows 250. 2) find_all_items('الو')=[] and find_all_items('پياز')=[] because rate-list lacks those spellings; note پياز (Pashto, Arabic yeh U+064A) != پیاز (rate-list, Urdu yeh U+06CC) — a CODE-POINT mismatch, not only a missing word. 3) چینی already matches chini. 4) Punjabi `تن`(3) and `پنجاہ`(50) missing so `تن سو پنجاہ`=350 fails; ALL Pashto number words missing (يو دوه درې څلور پنځه شپږ اووه اته نهه لس شل پنځوس سل سوه زر). 5) TEA ALREADY EXISTS as rate-list item chai_patti (SAMPLE price 1600) with aliases چائے/چائے کی پتی but NOT Punjabi چاہ پتی — add aliases, do NOT create a new item.
